QUOTE: `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init(buf, len)` (memory_buffer_alloc.c:566–600) is the library's own allocator. It makes a heap out of a caller-supplied buffer and installs its own `buffer_alloc_calloc` / `buffer_alloc_free` through the same setter.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the buffer allocator's init function installs its own calloc/free via the runtime setter. It never says "only in-tree user", but it does name the allocator as the library's own user of the setter, and that is enough.
